text:
Situation: Cefuroxime inventory is low at both campuses. Corvale East has 158 vials (10.5 days on hand). Corvale General has 367.55 vials (25.6 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): The product label identifies HIKMA FARMACEUTICA (PORTUGAL), S.A. (FEI 3002807173) as the manufacturing plant. FDA inspection 876911 ended 2014-03-28 and was classified Official Action Indicated (OAI) with six observations including absence of written procedures and deviations from laboratory control requirements. A Warning Letter was issued to the plant on 2014-10-21. Subsequent inspections in 2015, 2016, 2020, and 2023 were classified Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI). Cefuroxime is not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is constrained but not listed as a national shortage. We must secure alternative sources to maintain continuity.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to qualify and purchase cefuroxime from B. Braun Medical Inc.; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to qualify and purchase cefuroxime from Sagent Pharmaceuticals; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: No action.
